Method of Attack: Signed malicious Windows kernel drivers used to evade detection by security software
Terminate security software processes running on Windows devices
Force-delete files by freeing handles and terminating running processes
Impacted Systems: Windows 64-bit systems with enforced driver signature policies
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious driver file 'ktgn.sys' dropped in %Temp% folder
User mode program 'tjr.exe' loading the driver
Digital signature of ktgn.sys revoked but still loads on 64-bit Windows
Use of stolen or leaked cross-signing certificate for driver signing
